title: Menace Modmaki
description: A Minecraft mod adding a certain cat maid as an adoptable companion.
body:
Menace Modmaki
==============

A Minecraft mod adding a certain cat maid as an adoptable companion.

Features
========
- New sweet potato crop with golden variants
- Tameable Menace with sweet potatoes
- Fights with you
- Picks up flowers (cute)

Where to find her
=================
She loves the smell of fresh flowers and will appear in biomes heavily featuring them. You may also find her taking a trip to the beach.
